clips.title: The story
paras: Old Serra'kis is an ancient, massive threshadon dwelling in the submerged subterranean waters of Blackfathom Deeps. Hidden in a flooded cave beneath the ruins, the enormous beast is lethal to any who seek it out.

The Twilight's Hammer has made its home in the sunken Moonshrine Ruins, but the dark waters beneath the Moonshrine Sanctum hide older, wilder things. Old Serra'kis, the largest threshadon in the sunken temple, lurks in the Forgotten Pool, a flooded cave beneath the ruins where few would think to look.
